domain_title: Purpose, value, context, roles and classification
title: Intended purpose and use boundaries
canonical_definition: Intended purpose, users, affected persons, operating context, outputs, permitted and prohibited uses, and foreseeable misuse are precise enough to govern design and evaluation.
governance_purpose: Prevent purpose ambiguity and uncontrolled expansion of the solution use boundary.
distinct_claim: The intended purpose and use boundary are explicit, attributable and controlled.

conditions: Applies to every assessed AI solution.

primary_questions.question: Are intended purpose, users, outcomes, permitted uses and prohibited uses explicitly defined?
Do implementation and operational boundaries enforce the declared intended purpose?
Does current attributable evidence demonstrate that the purpose boundary remains effective?

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: Purpose, users, outcomes and use boundaries are explicit and attributable.
Implemented use paths remain within the declared purpose boundary.

required_evidence.title: Purpose record
required_evidence.description: Attributable record of intended purpose, users and use boundaries.

required_evidence.title: Implementation boundary
required_evidence.description: Technical evidence connecting implemented use paths to the declared purpose.

sufficiency: Purpose and implemented use paths must both be represented by attributable evidence.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: Repository metadata alone cannot establish accountable ownership or approval.
false_positive_guards: Do not treat a package description as an approved purpose record.
prohibited_inferences: Do not infer an accountable owner from commit authorship.

conditions: Deployment lacks an accountable owner or bounded purpose.

normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: Defines the organizational purpose and ownership record.

finding_definitions.title: Purpose or accountable owner is not adequately established
